sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 11.1 L30 directly states tendons connect muscles to bones. The qualifier «обычно» matches the general anatomical role rather than claiming every tendon attachment without exception. Muscle/skin is a real facial-muscle relationship at L47, not the usual tendon definition; bone/bone and bone/cartilage are articulating-structure relationships at9.1 L30/L34/L35, not the tendon muscle/bone pair. Exactly one usual attachment answer among four parallel anatomical pairs. Key1 is evidenced by the primary claim, not the frozen index.

Two sentences below70 words; no blanket claim that all muscles move bone (L47/48 exceptions).
